treatment_plan.notes: Routine medical advice and follow-up consultation if any discomfort occurs. Repaired after three months.

source_handle: Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. 4% articaine local infiltration anesthesia, remove the decay and prepare the hole, use proximal repair system, rubber dam moisture isolation system, dry, acid etching and rinse, dry, apply adhesive, light blow and light, 3M nano resin filling, Light curing, shaping, polishing.
